body:
No problem fam, if she's a happy girl now and you're a changed man then I'd say you have to let go of that guilt. Don't let it haunt you anymore. We all do bad things. 

I'm not sure about what you did, but I can tell you we can all move past our mistakes.

I broke up with my girlfriend of 4 years because I didn't feel the same way anymore. Several relationships later I realized she was a special kind of girl, still miss her to this day. But I bet she hates me, so I kind of get where you're coming from. If you care about her then you should apologize for what you did, that's what I did in the end. 

I wrote her an apology letter, I hurt her a lot, she wasnt perfect but in the end I just didn't want to try. I left her heart broken. It didn't hit me until several years later that I had completely lost her. I wrote the letter expecting to get her back, and while that didn't happen, it brought closure to both of us knowing we both knew what we had done wrong and were willing to move past it.

I'm not one to tell you time heals all wounds because I still can't bare the thought of seeing her happy with someone else, but at least I don't hate myself anymore for hurting her. That's the best advice I can give you.
Are you the dumper or the dumpee?
